mock.focusTitle: The cost of choice, and what I truly want
mock.scheduledDescription: Set aside 30 minutes to explore what this direction is asking of you.
mock.moveDescription: Drink a glass of water every day at 12:00.
mock.replyAlive: What feels most alive when you picture the next chapter of your work?
mock.replyLoss: It sounds like the decision is carrying the weight of every future possibility. Which loss feels hardest to accept?
mock.replyEnergy: Where are you spending energy that your role no longer requires from you?
mock.replyProgress: What has changed because of your effort, even if the work is not finished yet?
mock.replyAttention: What seemed to take most of your attention today?
mock.replyHolding: You’ve been holding this question for a while. What seems to take most of your attention when you sit with it?
mock.replyTangible: I hear a wish to choose with honesty, without pretending there is no cost. Let’s make that insight tangible.
mock.replyTrue: What changes when you say that out loud? Stay with the part that feels unexpectedly true.
